idea-plugin.name: PipelinePilot for Jenkins
idea-plugin.description:
Edit, validate and run Jenkins pipelines from the IDE without the commit-push-wait loop.

PipelinePilot brings a fast, interactive workflow to Jenkins Pipeline development. Instead of emulating Jenkins locally, it connects your IDE to a real Jenkins instance: the editor handles the experience, Jenkins handles validation and execution on real agents, plugins, shared libraries and credentials.

Features
  • Instant validation — inline diagnostics from the Jenkins declarative linter, on save or on demand.
  • Quick-fixes — deterministic and AI-assisted intentions on linter errors.
  • Remote sandbox execution — press Ctrl+Enter to run the current Jenkinsfile on real Jenkins, isolated and ephemeral.
  • Live logs & stage graph — streamed console output and a visual graph of sequential, parallel and nested stages.
  • Replay — rerun the whole pipeline, only failed stages, or a single stage.
  • Shared library awareness — @Library detection, step autocomplete and navigation into vars/.
  • AI assistance — inline review with per-line findings and one-click fixes, via any OpenAI-compatible provider (OpenAI, OpenRouter, Ollama, LM Studio, custom gateways).
Getting started
  1. Open Settings | Tools | PipelinePilot for Jenkins and set your Jenkins URL, username and API token.
  2. Open a Jenkinsfile and save it to see inline validation.
  3. Press Ctrl+Enter to run it in a remote sandbox and watch logs and stages stream back.
Links: Documentation & source · Issue tracker
